flow_asset_id.description: Google Flow asset ID (opaque identifier from Flow API)

flow_asset_label.description: Human-readable label shown in Flow UI (e.g., 'Master Image - Hanok')

local_path.description: Local filesystem path (CLI/render use only, never in canonical JSON)

source_scene_id.description: Source scene ID for relay frames (scene N-1 for scene N's start frame)

confirmed_by_user.description: Whether user has confirmed this asset in Flow UI

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of file content for dedup/verification (hex)

lineage_revision.description: Source revision of the plan that produced this asset
